steps.clue: Activate the Sentinel Artifact and unlock Pack-a-Punch at the four pedestals.
Read the altered clocks and set the elemental dials around the ship.
Kill matching elemental Catalysts beside the four sparking outlets.
Complete the Poison, Water, Electric and Fire trials in order to recover the Sentinel Artifact.
Use the Poison Kraken to shoot the nine pipes and flood the Turbine Room.
Place the Sentinel Artifact inside the Turbine Room’s Pack-a-Punch machine.
Activate the nine planet symbols and reveal their order using the Cargo Hold model.
Shoot the planets in the displayed order and collect their falling orbs.
Collect the Sun orb and destroy the ice blocks from the Forecastle to the Poop Deck.
Enter the final ritual and recover the Sentinel Artifact underwater.
Survive the five arenas and defeat the Eye of Odin.
